ops.body: Round-3 refuter on bba8159c: NOT clean — but G2 (retention synchronous at detach.py:113, cancellation stops via retained PID without the pidfile) and G4 (kind required at failures.py:142, infra_retries/infra_cost consume one filtered stream — no split-brain) HOLD, plus the entire prior confirmed set. Two HIGHs where the old assume-zero default survives on one path + one MED: (1) G3 validation sequenced AFTER the retry sidecar write — reproduced: NaN driver cost → infra retry persists it to the sidecar (malformed-skip → summed 0) → retry succeeds at 0.0 → journal-append validation never fires; (2) G1 classifier keys off the complete literal 'total_cost_usd' — reproduced: empty log → 0.0, truncated mid-key → 0.0 (only complete-key-no-value correctly aborts); (3) MED accounting aborts raise with NO durable marker — a restart sees fully-accounted state and re-runs the unit. A3.5 dispatched (round 4) with branch-deleting semantics: H1 validation at the earliest consumption point (structurally nothing poisoned persists anywhere); H2 INVERTED default — post-spawn, only a complete parseable envelope yields a number, everything else aborts (the no-evidence→0 branch is deleted; pre-spawn cancel stays zero; yes, most real mid-proposal wall-cancels now abort loudly — the principle applied consistently); M1 shielded kind=accounting_abort breadcrumb (no cost number) + resume refuses while unreconciled (manual reconciliation documented, no CLI flags). A6b DESIGN NOTE for later: decide how the campaign runner ledgers/halts on AccountingIntegrityError — unknown spend breaks reservation arithmetic, lean campaign-halt (kill-switch philosophy).
